purpose: Built-in source catalog for subscription import and server discovery
important_notice: Список URL предоставлен пользователем. Доступность, безопасность, актуальность и содержимое URL не проверены.
Не классифицировать источник только по названию: WHITELIST/BLACKLIST могут обозначать разные типы содержимого.
Каждый источник сначала загрузить безопасным способом и определить фактический формат содержимого.
Источники с доменами/IP/CIDR/правилами маршрутизации не должны попадать в список VPN-серверов.
Все источники отключены по умолчанию до проверки и явного включения пользователем/владельцем продукта.

pipeline: Fetch enabled source with strict timeout, response-size limit, HTTPS validation and safe redirect handling.
Prevent SSRF: reject localhost, private, link-local, multicast and reserved destinations after DNS resolution and after every redirect; defend against DNS rebinding.
Use ETag and Last-Modified where available; apply per-host rate limits and backoff.
Detect content type and format. Parse only supported subscription formats such as VLESS, VMess, Trojan and Shadowsocks.
Classify domain/IP/CIDR routing lists separately from server subscriptions.
Normalize parsed nodes, preserve source provenance, deduplicate by canonicalized configuration fingerprint without logging secrets.
Resolve country/city from reliable endpoint IP geolocation when possible; do not infer country from source name or node remark alone. If unknown, show Unknown.
Test candidate nodes through the actual Xray engine or a valid protocol handshake. A TCP port-open check alone is not proof that a proxy works.
Only mark a node Working after a successful end-to-end proxy test to a controlled health-check endpoint.
Measure latency with a named method and timestamp. Measure download/upload only with a controlled, bandwidth-limited test endpoint.
Store last_checked_at, check_method, latency_ms, download_mbps, upload_mbps, status, failure_reason_code and source_ids.
Do not expose credentials or full subscription URIs in logs, analytics, crash reports or UI diagnostics.

visibility_policy.working_definition: Только успешная end-to-end проверка через Xray/proxy handshake и контрольный health endpoint. Открытый TCP-порт сам по себе не означает Working.

refresh.note: Backend scheduler target is every 30 minutes. Android WorkManager is best-effort and cannot guarantee exact 30-minute execution.
